title: OpenAI working on new $30B raise at $1.25T valuation ahead of IPO
summary: Should OpenAI command an over $1 trillion valuation with this round, it would break records as the most highly valued private company ever.
title_es: OpenAI busca recaudar $30B a valuación de $1.25T antes del IPO
bajada: OpenAI está en conversaciones para una nueva ronda de financiación de $30 mil millones que la valoraría en $1.25 billones, lo que la establecería como la compañía privada más valiosa de la historia. La ronda incluye inversores de los Emiratos Árabes Unidos y Coatue Management.
bajada_en: OpenAI is pursuing a $30 billion funding round valuing the company at $1.25 trillion, establishing it as the most valuable private company ever. The round includes investors from the UAE and Coatue Management.

title: OpenAI Fundraising Round Set to Close Soon With UAE Investors, Coatue Leading Investment
summary: OpenAI is aiming to close a $30 billion fundraising round that will value the AI company at up to $1.25 trillion, not including the new investment, before the end of next week, according to a person familiar with the deal.New York-based investment firm Coatue Management and investors from the ...
title_es: OpenAI cierra ronda de $30B con líderes como Coatue y inversores de UAE
bajada: La ronda de financiación de OpenAI por $30 mil millones está cerca de cerrarse, con Coatue Management liderando la inversión y participación de fondos de los Emiratos Árabes Unidos. El cierre se espera antes de fin de mes.
bajada_en: OpenAI's $30 billion funding round is set to close soon with Coatue Management leading and UAE investors participating. Closing is expected before month's end.

title: Canva releases its first image generation model
summary: Canva is making its new image model available to all users, promising better, more customizable performance at lower costs.
title_es: Canva lanza su propio modelo de generación de imágenes
bajada: Canva presentó su modelo de generación de imágenes, disponible para todos sus usuarios con mejor rendimiento y mayor personalización a menor costo. El modelo, llamado Canva Craft, compite directamente con soluciones de OpenAI, Microsoft y Google.
bajada_en: Canva launched its own image generation model, available to all users with improved performance and greater customization at lower costs. Called Canva Craft, it directly competes with solutions from OpenAI, Microsoft, and Google.

title: Salesforce Customers Brace For New Fees to Use Claude in Its Apps
summary: Salesforce is leading the software industry’s attempt to collect fees from businesses that use Claude and other external AI tools to automate work in enterprise apps.As soon as next month, Salesforce plans to require companies to register outside AI agents, a step toward charging them each time those agents update or analyze data stored in Salesforce. The fees let Salesforce earn money from customers who use such AI instead of paying for Salesforce’s built-in AI products.The Salesforce tollgate has implications for the rest of the industry, which is coming to terms with the idea that so-called AI agents may be able to use software firms’ apps more efficiently than humans do, meaning their seat-based or per-user pricing model might not have staying power. The question is whether the new AI tollgates—which Atlassian, Workday, ServiceNow and Datadog are also erecting to various extents—and other pricing shifts will more than make up for an eventual decline in per-seat subscription revenues.The vast majority of workers haven’t yet outsourced such work to AI, of course, and companies like Salesforce are trying to get more revenue from them as well. They charge fees based on how much they use the apps’ built-in AI tools and are also experimenting with outcome-based pricing, meaning customers only pay when such tools actually complete a task successfully or help the customers make more money.For now, Salesforce and some other software firms developing tollgates for customers’ AI agents haven’t started charging the tolls. They’re letting customers experiment for free with the technology a little while longer. (The customers still have to pay providers such as Anthropic to use the AI agents in the first place.)Starting around November, according to thecompany’s website, Salesforce will require customers to register any externally-made AI agents if they plan to use them to take actions on their behalf in Salesforce apps. title_es: Salesforce cobrará por uso de Claude en sus aplicaciones
bajada: Salesforce comenzará a cobrar a empresas por usar Claude y otras herramientas IA externas en sus aplicaciones, implementando un modelo de "peaje IA" basado en operaciones de agentes. Esta estrategia refleja cómo el software empresarial se adapta a la era de los agentes IA.
bajada_en: Salesforce will charge companies for using Claude and external AI tools in its apps, implementing an 'AI toll' model based on agent operations. This strategy reflects how enterprise software adapts to the AI agent era.

title: Build more responsive apps with the Decisions API
summary: Fast, focused, low-cost decisions for any application.
title_es: OpenAI lanza Decisions API para aplicaciones más responsivas
bajada: OpenAI presentó la Decisions API, una nueva herramienta diseñada para tomar decisiones rápidas, enfocadas y de bajo costo en cualquier aplicación. La API promete mejorar la responsividad de apps que requieren decisiones en tiempo real sin comprometer costos.
bajada_en: OpenAI introduced the Decisions API, a new tool designed for fast, focused, and low-cost decision-making in any application. The API aims to improve responsiveness in apps requiring real-time decisions without compromising costs.

title: NVIDIA Unveils Minerva to Bring End-to-End Observability for AI Factories
summary: Launched today, NVIDIA Minerva is an AIOps platform built to help teams find problems earlier and keep AI factories productive. It brings together telemetry from infrastructure and AI workloads, then applies purpose-built AI models to turn that data into timely, actionable insight. AI factories are among the most complex operations in the world, with vast […]
title_es: NVIDIA presenta Minerva para observabilidad integral en AI factories
bajada: NVIDIA lanzó Minerva, una plataforma AIOps que proporciona observabilidad end-to-end para operaciones de AI. Combina telemetría de infraestructura y cargas de trabajo de IA con modelos especializados para detectar problemas anticipadamente y mantener productivas las AI factories.
bajada_en: NVIDIA launched Minerva, an AIOps platform providing end-to-end observability for AI operations. It combines telemetry from infrastructure and AI workloads with specialized models to identify problems early and keep AI factories productive.

title: NVIDIA Cosmos Opens New Tools to Train, Evaluate and Deploy World Models
summary: To help developers rapidly build world models, which help physical AI systems understand and simulate the real world, NVIDIA has expanded the Cosmos platform with new training tools, simulation checkpoints and Cosmos Data Factory blueprints.  Ranking top five on six different open models leaderboards, the NVIDIA Cosmos platform gives world model builders the frontier open […]
title_es: NVIDIA Cosmos expande herramientas para entrenar world models
bajada: NVIDIA amplió su plataforma Cosmos con nuevas herramientas de entrenamiento y checkpoints de simulación para facilitar el desarrollo de world models. La plataforma lidera en seis leaderboards de modelos abiertos, posicionándose como referencia para sistemas de IA física.
bajada_en: NVIDIA expanded its Cosmos platform with new training tools and simulation checkpoints to simplify world model development. The platform ranks top five on six open models leaderboards, establishing itself as a reference for physical AI systems.

title: Canva’s first AI image model plans designs before generating them
summary: Canva is diving even deeper into AI with the launch of an image generation model that competes directly with those from OpenAI, Microsoft, and Google. The model, called Canva Craft, uses a two-stage architecture that allows it to plan a design before generating an image, allowing for "greater precision, consistency and control," according to an […]
title_es: Canva Craft usa arquitectura de dos etapas para mayor precisión
bajada: El modelo Canva Craft utiliza una arquitectura de dos etapas que planifica el diseño antes de generar la imagen, permitiendo mayor precisión, consistencia y control. Este enfoque diferencia la solución de Canva en el competitivo mercado de generación de imágenes.
bajada_en: Canva Craft uses a two-stage architecture that plans designs before generating images, enabling greater precision, consistency, and control. This approach differentiates Canva's solution in the competitive image generation market.

title: 1Password launches a way for AI agents to log in on your behalf without seeing your password
summary: The new feature allows agents to log into a customer's personal accounts while still protecting the private credentials that secure those accounts.
title_es: 1Password permite que agentes IA accedan sin ver contraseñas
bajada: 1Password lanzó una nueva funcionalidad que permite a agentes IA iniciar sesión en cuentas personales sin acceder a las credenciales privadas. Esta solución aborda una brecha crítica de seguridad en la automatización de agentes.
bajada_en: 1Password launched a feature enabling AI agents to log into personal accounts without accessing private credentials. This solution addresses a critical security gap in agent automation.

title: Hugging Face’s New AI Biology Model Lets You Chat With DNA
summary: The new open-source model speaks the language of DNA and can help researchers understand the effects of any changes on gene activity and health.
title_es: Hugging Face presenta modelo IA que permite conversar con ADN
bajada: Hugging Face lanzó un modelo open-source especializado en biología que comprende y analiza secuencias de ADN como si fuera lenguaje natural. Los investigadores pueden usarlo para predecir efectos de cambios genéticos en la salud y actividad de genes.
bajada_en: Hugging Face released an open-source biology model that understands and analyzes DNA sequences like natural language. Researchers can use it to predict genetic changes' effects on health and gene activity.

title: Microsoft’s Mustafa Suleyman says its AI outperforms doctors on hard cases as he chases ‘medical superintelligence’
summary: Microsoft’s new AI diagnostic system beat generalist doctors on hard cases, according to a study in Science. But most of the improvement seems to come from the AI models underneath, not from Microsoft’s system itself.
title_es: IA de Microsoft supera a doctores en diagnósticos difíciles
bajada: Un estudio publicado en Science muestra que el sistema de diagnóstico IA de Microsoft supera a médicos generalistas en casos complejos. Sin embargo, la mejora proviene principalmente de los modelos base subyacentes más que del sistema de Microsoft específicamente.
bajada_en: A study in Science shows Microsoft's AI diagnostic system outperforms generalist doctors on complex cases. However, the improvement comes primarily from underlying foundation models rather than Microsoft's system specifically.

title: OlmoEarth v1.3: State-of-the-art embeddings for the whole planet
title_es: OlmoEarth v1.3: embeddings de vanguardia para todo el planeta
bajada: Hugging Face presentó OlmoEarth v1.3, un modelo de embeddings open-source de última generación diseñado para datos geoespaciales globales. El modelo amplía las capacidades de IA para aplicaciones relacionadas con observación terrestre y análisis ambiental.
bajada_en: Hugging Face released OlmoEarth v1.3, a state-of-the-art open-source embedding model designed for global geospatial data. The model expands AI capabilities for Earth observation and environmental analysis applications.

title: Turning Database Grading into RL Rewards: Post-Training Agents with ThinkingBox
title_es: Microsoft entrena agentes IA con recompensas basadas en bases de datos
bajada: Microsoft desarrolló ThinkingBox, una técnica innovadora que convierte la evaluación de bases de datos en recompensas para el entrenamiento con reinforcement learning. Este enfoque mejora la capacidad de agentes IA para interactuar efectivamente con sistemas de datos.
bajada_en: Microsoft developed ThinkingBox, an innovative technique converting database grading into RL rewards for agent training. This approach improves AI agents' ability to interact effectively with data systems.

title: OpenShell – A safe, private runtime for fleets of autonomous AI agents
title_es: NVIDIA OpenShell: runtime seguro para flotas de agentes IA autónomos
bajada: NVIDIA lanzó OpenShell, un runtime de código abierto diseñado para ejecutar flotas de agentes IA autónomos de forma segura y privada. La herramienta aborda desafíos de seguridad y gobernanza en sistemas multi-agente.
bajada_en: NVIDIA released OpenShell, an open-source runtime for safely and privately running fleets of autonomous AI agents. The tool addresses security and governance challenges in multi-agent systems.

title: Why Blackstone Thinks AI Bottlenecks Could Work in its Favor
summary: Greetings!On their earnings calls earlier in the week, Meta Platforms and SpaceX delivered the same underlying message to investors: demand for AI is running ahead of the supply of AI compute. On Thursday, another important player in the AI ecosystem—Blackstone, the alternative asset management giant—repeated a version of that refrain.On its own earnings call, the firm, a major investor at the center of the AI data center boom, faced pointed questions from analysts about rising financing costs and mounting investor concerns over the sustainability of the buildout. Its executives argued that the very factors threatening the AI industry’s expansion could actually work in Blackstone’s favor. CEO Steve Schwarzman noted that constraints on power availability and growing public opposition to new data centers are making it harder to bring new capacity online, potentially making existing facilities more valuable. Blackstone President Jon Gray also suggested the firm could seek higher returns on projects where it hasn’t signed leases yet in order to offset rising borrowing costs.Blackstone’s third-quarter results offered some support for that argument: Its infrastructure investments were buoyed by what executives called “extraordinary” data center leasing momentum, significantly outperforming its broader private equity and real estate holdings. “Despite all the negative things you’re reading about AI today, when we look across our business, this continues to be the area where we’re driving the highest returns,” Gray said during the call.But it’s hard to ignore the fact that the financing concerns and roadblocks threatening the broader AI infrastructure buildout are also hitting closer to home for Blackstone. Fears about rising financing costs have sent CoreWeave’s stock and bond prices plunging—the neocloud’s shares closed down another 10% Thursday after sliding last week—while Australian AI cloud provider Firmus abruptly pulled its initial public offering earlier this month
title_es: Blackstone ve oportunidades en cuello de botella de computación IA
bajada: Blackstone, líder en inversión en infraestructura, argumenta que las limitaciones de energía y capacidad de cómputo en IA podrían beneficiar sus centros de datos existentes. Los ejecutivos sugieren que restricciones de poder y oposición pública aumentarán el valor de las instalaciones actuales.
bajada_en: Blackstone, a leader in infrastructure investment, argues that AI computing bottlenecks could benefit its existing data centers. Executives suggest power constraints and public opposition will increase facility values.
